author: Ari Koslow
title: Shane McClanahan to start Sunday
desc: Shane McClanahan will start on Sunday against the Red Sox.
impact: McClanahan will close out the first series back from the All-Star break for the Rays. He posted a stifling 2.83 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ian Seymour to start Saturday for Rays
desc: Ian Seymour will start on Saturday against the Red Sox.
impact: Seymour finished the first half of the season struggling against Seattle following a solid stretch. He enters the second half with a 4.59 ERA.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Jax to start Game 1 of doubleheader Friday
desc: Griffin Jax will start Game 1 of Friday's doubleheader against the Red Sox.
impact: It is still TBD as to who will start in Game 2. Jax entered the All-Star break allowing three runs or less in seven straight starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cam Schlittler to start Sunday
desc: Cam Schlittler will start on Sunday against the Dodgers.
impact: Schlittler will close out the Yankees first series back from the All-Star break. He'll take the mound opposite of Yoshinobu Yamamoto.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Ryan Weathers to start Saturday for Yankees
desc: Ryan Weathers will start on Saturday against the Dodgers.
impact: Weathers allowed just one run over 5 1/3 innings against the Nationals before the All-Star break. He'll look to continue the momentum after struggling in June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Gerrit Cole to start Friday
desc: Gerrit Cole will start on Friday against the Dodgers.
impact: Cole will take the mound first out of the All-Star break for the Yankees. He began to turn things around in July after a rough month of June.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani (knee) will not pitch this weekend
desc: The Dodgers are not having Shohei Ohtani start on the mound in the team's first series back from the All-Star break.
impact: Ohtani had his knee drained last Sunday following the Dodgers final game before the All-Star break. It will be Roki Sasaki, Emmet Sheehan and Yoshinobu Yamamoto starting this weekend.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yoshinobu Yamamoto to start Sunday
desc: Yoshinobu Yamamoto will start for the Dodgers on Sunday against the Yankees.
impact: Yamamoto will close out the first series back from the All-Star break for the Dodgers. He will be looking to bounce back after allowing six runs to the Diamondbacks right before the break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emmet Sheehan to start Saturday for Dodgers
desc: Emmet Sheehan will start on Saturday against the Yankees.
impact: Sheehan posted a 4.81 ERA across the first half of the season. He finished strong, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last three starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Roki Sasaki to start Friday for Dodgers
desc: Roki Sasaki will start on Friday against the Yankees.
impact: Sasaki will take the mound first for the Dodgers out of the All-Star break. He posted a 5.33 ERA during the first half of the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bo Bichette (leg/ankle) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Bo Bichette returns to the New York Mets' lineup for Thursday's game against the Philadelphia Phillies, starting at third base and batting third.
impact: Bichette has been sidelined since July 10 due to leg and ankle soreness but will return to the Mets' lineup in their first game following the All-Star break. He owns a .255/.300/.376 slash line with 10 home runs across 96 games this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Logan Gilbert to start Sunday versus Giants
desc: Logan Gilbert will start on Sunday against the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Gilbert gets the nod on Sunday and will face the Giants, who finished the first half of the season with a .251/.311/.417 slash line and a 19.9 K% against right-handed pitching. He owns a 3.32 ERA and 0.99 WHIP with 119 strikeouts across 114 innings this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryan Woo to start Saturday versus Giants
desc: Bryan Woo will start on Saturday against the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Woo gets the nod on Saturday and will face the Giants, who finished the first half of the season with a .251/.311/.417 slash line and a 19.9 K% against right-handed pitching. He owns a 4.23 ERA and 1.07 WHIP with 102 strikeouts across 104.1 innings this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Bryce Miller to start Friday versus Giants
desc: Bryce Miller will start on Friday against the San Francisco Giants.
impact: Miller gets the nod first following the All-Star break and will face the Giants, who finished the first half of the season with a .251/.311/.417 slash line and a 19.9 K% against right-handed pitching. He owns a 2.18 ERA and 0.83 WHIP with 65 strikeouts across 57.2 innings this season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Justin Crawford (knee) returns to lineup Thursday
desc: Justin Crawford returns to the Philadelphia Phillies' lineup for Thursday's game against the New York Mets, starting in center field and batting ninth.
impact: Crawford missed last weekend's series against the Tigers due to left knee soreness. He completed a pregame workout on Sunday and is ready to return to action on Thursday. The 22-year-old has slashed .263/.312/.353 with two home runs and 12 stolen bases across 88 games this season.
